title: Homogenization of some viscous Hamilton--Jacobi equations using variational arguments on probability spaces
summary: This work studies the asymptotic behavior of a class of viscous Hamilton--Jacobi equations with oscillatory periodic potentials, already studied by other authors in the PDE framework, and described in terms of an effective Hamiltonian. A novel variational approach is introduced, based on the classical stochastic control representation involving a Brownian motion, which allows the problem to be reformulated in terms of functionals defined on probability spaces.
